reached_sql:
WITH catalog_sales_returns AS (
    SELECT cs_order_number, cs_item_sk, cs_warehouse_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_sales_price, COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) AS refunded_cash
    FROM catalog_sales
    LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk)
),
date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01'
)
SELECT w_state, i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs_sold_date_sk < (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) FROM date_range) THEN cs_sales_price - refunded_cash ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs_sold_date_sk >= (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) FROM date_range) THEN cs_sales_price - refunded_cash ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_sales_returns
JOIN warehouse ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk
WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
